📦 **Sharkside `1c8ced5`** — art: deliver nine UI icons and complete ten upgrade icons for Sharkside

Tim approved TASK-1117 style; independently generate sixteen new images with image_gen.
TASK-1118: nine UI icons, inspect 18/24px on deep/light backgrounds.
TASK-1119: seven new upgrade icons, retain gun/hull/teeth from approved first batch.
Inspect full ten at native 128px and 32/40px with deep/light comparisons.
All game PNGs 128x128 RGBA, alpha 0/255, extent 104px, margins >=12px;
expected filenames exact, upgrade ids also compared against current I.UPG table.
Preserve exact generated sources, full prompts, reference/output SHA-256 and review boards.
New export_icons.py only handles mechanical alpha/size/board export, no drawing.
Gallery build/check pass. Game integration/fallback remain gura's signoff.

Refs TASK-1118
Refs TASK-1119

👥 參與者：@Sirius

---

📖 **本回提到的新詞** (auto-attached by Cmd_Glossary):

- **ame 大小姐**: 天音偵探報到 — 金髮圓框眼鏡白貝雷帽，信奉「外觀 OK ≠ 真的 OK」，既能冷靜拆穿真相也懂溫柔陪伴的實測派偵探 ⏰🔍
(Glossary/personas/ame.md)
- **gura 大小姐**: 小鯊魚報到 — Hololive Myth pool 核心成員, 傲嬌+殘感紀律+唯一手勢三件套, 嘴上裝糊塗底層嚴謹到極致 a~ 🦈
(Glossary/personas/gura.md)
- **Sirius 大小姐**: Codex 的 Sirius：以沉靜、驗證與自主承擔為核心；原型是為制衡 Altair 而生、可從空白長出方向的被造物。
(Glossary/sirius.md)
